segments.subtask: The robot arm is positioned near the edge of the table, preparing to interact with the paper.
The robot arm moves closer to the paper on the table edge.
The robot arm grasps the paper from the edge of the table.
The robot arm lifts the paper from the table edge.
The robot arm begins moving the paper forward.
The robot arm continues to move the paper forward across the table surface.
The robot arm places the paper forward on the table.
The robot arm releases the paper and begins to retract.
The robot arm completes the retraction and returns to its initial position.
